verdict.score_rationale: The board is comfortably readable at the 7 anchor, with spacious, instantly distinguishable regions and mostly clean flows, though several long cross-region routes and small text require extra eye travel.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Labels and nodes generally have ample clearance, but the small type inside nodes and chips is less comfortable at arm's length.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Tinted, titled regions clearly separate admission, execution, concurrency, durability, lifecycle, and snapshot reachability.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: Arrowheads, colors, styles, and labels are mostly clear, but the long blue reattach route, dashed subtask route, and lifecycle paths spanning region boundaries demand tracing.

sub_checks.name: density_and_decomposition
sub_checks.note: The central turn loop and supporting subsystems are well decomposed, though large explanatory notes and the detached bottom snapshot example make the overall reading sequence less immediate.
